top_signals.title: Paramount Set to Settle Lawsuits, Clearing Way for Warner Bros. Deal
top_signals.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. has reached a settlement with California and other states that were suing to stop its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., according to a person familiar with the matter. Talks took place over the weekend. The official deal is expected to be announced Monday. Bloomberg's Chris Palmeri reports from Los Angeles. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AMD Set to Top $1 Trillion in Market Value as Chip Stocks Soar
top_signals.summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. shares jumped Monday, putting the company on track to close above $1 trillion in market value for the first time amid renewed optimism for chipmakers necessary to power artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
